title: Collection
description: A released collection (drop) of one brand: the products whose `collection` equals `name`. Only released collections are visible; a held collection does not exist for retailers (proposal 0006).

name.description: Equals `Product.collection` of every product in the collection (exact, case-sensitive).

released_at.description: When the collection became visible: the scheduled `release_at`, or the time of the write that released it.
